'''Jashwa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jashwik]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] cousin-[[Species/Legends|species]].
